prompt: What is a memory leak in Java?
choices: When new fails to allocate memory
When objects that are no longer needed are still referenced, preventing GC from reclaiming them
When too many local variables are on the stack
When static fields are declared with the wrong type
explanation: Java GC only collects unreachable objects. If you keep references to objects you no longer need (e.g., in a static collection), the objects cannot be collected. Example: adding to a static List without ever removing entries causes a memory leak.
